svg.title: Post-remediation release performance: 288 paired Criterion workloads

cc:Work.dc:title: Post-remediation release performance: 288 paired Criterion workloads
cc:Work.dc:description: Candidate-to-baseline median ratios for two alternating release/LTO measurement rounds. Lower ratios are faster. The twelve workloads slower by more than five percent in both rounds are highlighted.
